purpose: Compact public-safe projection of work whose next lawful move depends on human observation, choice, permission, private input, or physical action. This is not the machine execution queue.
laws: An item belongs here only when the next meaningful move cannot be lawfully completed from current machine/public evidence alone.
Each item names one smallest human move and the machine move it unlocks.
Sensitive/private content is never stored here; keep only a public-safe dependency description.
Ordinary use may satisfy a waiting item; no dedicated QA ritual is required unless the evidence gate specifically needs one.
When evidence arrives, close or transform the item rather than letting it become permanent backlog.

items.human_move: When ready, authorize/test Health Connect on the Android phone and expose one tiny proof stream: sleep + heart rate.
items.why: The public repo cannot prove device permissions, source availability, or phone-side data.
items.unlocks: Map Health Connect records into the existing 0xxx0/body-sensor-observation/v0.1 envelope without creating a new health store.
items.privacy: No raw personal health data is committed to the public repo.

items.why: Calibration and intervention effects require actual within-person returns; synthetic data would only test plumbing.
items.unlocks: Run one bounded comparison, decide KEEP / DROP / UNKNOWN, then FADE monitoring when additional observation has low value.

items.human_move: Run the same saved BODY / FIT kit twice and leave RETURN + NEXT CUT after each run.
items.why: BODY / FIT 0.3 already names this as its ordinary-use proof gate.

items.human_move: Only when useful, provide the actual medication / supplement / caffeine list inside a private session.
items.why: A personalized interaction/timing review cannot be safely reconstructed from guesses, and the public repo should not contain the list.
items.unlocks: Normalize identities and run source-backed interaction / duplicate-ingredient / timing review while preserving prescription authority outside the inference engine.

capture_protocol.law: MENTION != OBLIGATION; EXPLICIT UNRESOLVED ASK != DISPOSABLE RESIDUE.

routes.condition: The next bounded move is executable now with current authority/evidence.
routes.destination: EXECUTE -> RETURN; use CURRENT/QUEUE only when it is actually selected live work.

routes.condition: The next meaningful move requires human observation, choice, permission, private input, physical action, or ordinary-use evidence.
The material is a possibility, curiosity, donor, or speculative branch with no present commitment.
routes.destination: IDEA ATLAS / SOCIAL RESIDUE / HOLD; not WAITING.

routes.condition: The material is evidence or a claim that may enter durable state.
routes.destination: FIELD INTAKE / CONTINUITY review gate before canon.
Keep private/local; if a public dependency pointer is useful, store only the minimum public-safe description.

capture_protocol.closure: A WAITING item must close, transform, or explicitly remain blocked when its named dependency changes; repeated mention alone does not duplicate it.
